data.description: Mandatory breach-notification scheme under Privacy Act 1988 (secid:regulation/oaic.gov.au/privacy-act) Part IIIC, in force since February 2018. Requires APP entities to notify OAIC and affected individuals of eligible data breaches likely to cause serious harm.
